notes.title: Hot new price for summer!
notes.content:
To celebrate the warmer weather (and the Steam Summer Sale that comes with it), Moriarty: Endgame VR has had its price slashed!

We listened to your feedback; you liked the experience but the price point was too high- so we’ve lowered it significantly, [b]and then dropped it by another 20%![/b]

Our fans and supporters are important; you guys have the opinions that matter and we’ll always take your feedback on board and do what we can to honour it. 

For those who’ve played it, why not dust it off and try for some of those achievements? And for those who wishlisted it- now’s the time to come back and give it a whirl.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1
notes.content:
- Texture and graphics upgrade within the following scenes and locations:
   - Main scene
   - Airship
   - 221b Baker St
- Enhanced support for Oculus Touch controllers, including controller UI
- Added new calibration features that allow the user to use the app freely within their space, in any direction
- Included new targeting reticle within calibration scene to improve position accuracy
- Added new slider to the Menu UI to control Grayscale intensity
